title: Stabilize Sketchpad Consolidation Tests
description: Stabilize compose/sketchpad after consolidation into Sketchpad.tsx. Fix remaining runtime regressions and Playwright failures without removing functionality. Current known issues include missing alias regressions after consolidation and runtime errors in kit/type/design flows.
summary: Consolidated compose sketchpad Playwright discovery so only the six app tests are registered and listed. Removed the root seed.spec.ts sketchpad drag spec, narrowed compose/sketchpad Playwright config to index.tsx, and added runtime app-test-only registration around the embedded sketchpad tests. Also stabilized app-state selector defaults and the lightweight Design app path used by the consolidated Design test.
